title: A New Railway for Kenya
subtitle: 考点：交通发展 / link, with ease, convenient
passage: Mombasa is a big port in Kenya, and Nairobi is its capital. In the past, goods had to go by lorry on a narrow, crowded road, and the trip was slow. Many drivers were tired, and some products arrived late.

Then a new railway linked the port with the capital. The railway was built with help from China. Now trains carry people and goods with ease. A manager at the port says, 'The railway is very convenient. Our business has grown.' Tourists also like it, because they can sometimes see wild animals from the train window. For many Kenyans, the railway is a real miracle.
